one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 live from the whole non-EVM cluster: Minswap V1's deployed validator is the post-audit fixed code (CEK-proven), DeDust rejects all 22 forged-message probes, Djed's $6.24M reserve requires an oracle-signed feed, and every other member's user paths are sender-scoped; ~$50.4M is holder-recoverable, ~$2.1k is bricked.
